about: Moments from the 2026-11-12 LAN playtest (Tam with Pip visiting Walid's world, and earlier sessions), rebuilt from the session logs and the context the gateway logged for each answer. The stub_ai answers are what the real AI did then; 'brain' checks must hold whatever the AI does, 'ai' checks and judge questions are about her own choices (live mode). Diary text in diary-real is written for the test.
